shape: a small thing you fought as a kid and would welcome now, pinned to one object

slides.text: at ten, being sent to bed at eight felt like a punishment. at twenty-four, in our flat, you closing my door was pure mercy.

caption:
we used to keep the kitchen light on until two in the morning.
now i am asleep before the news even starts.
send this to the flatmate who always checked the front door lock before bed.

#roommate #flatmate #growingup #home #friendship
alt: an oneliner post about how an early bedtime fought as a child became a welcome comfort provided by a flatmate later in life
hook_options: at ten, being sent to bed at eight felt like a punishment.
i spent ten years fighting an eight o'clock curfew.
at twelve, the hall light going off at nine was a sentence.
